text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — I'm planning a small refactor to support per-prefix TTLs and a softer demote window. Questions about the eviction contract and telemetry. TL;DR: want eviction score to consider TTL decay + tenant weight.

Alex Rivera: +1 to per-prefix TTLs. Quick Q: do we store TTL in slab metadata or per-prefix descriptor?

Priya Kapoor: Store on prefix descriptor imo. Slab is eviction unit, prefix may span slabs.

Samir Patel: Concern: adding TTL to descriptor means we need fast invalidation when TTL updates during rollouts. Could blow up write amplification.

Maria Chen: Good point. Idea: immutable descriptor with epoch; TTL updates create new epoch and we piggyback on existing manifest CAS to avoid extra writes.

Ben Torres: For eviction scoring: propose composite score = base_hotness * exp(-age/ttl) * tenant_factor. This decays gracefully and reduces thrash.

Alex Rivera: Nice. Need to ensure math stable. Edge-case: ttl=0 (no decay) vs ttl=infinite. Define sentinel value and avoid divide-by-zero.

Priya Kapoor: Also need telemetry: histogram of eviction latencies, count of demote->evict transitions, per-tenant score distribution. That helps tune tenant_factor and detect regressions.

Samir Patel: Ops: on rollout must be able to toggle decay off. Suggest feature flag that flips to legacy scoring. Also add safety threshold to force demote rather than full eviction under heavy churn.

Maria Chen: Rollout plan: feature flag -> canary (1% traffic) -> monitor eviction_churn, demote_ratio, tail L99 serve latency for 12h -> ramp.

evict-bot: Deploy scheduled: evict-scoring-refactor v1 -> canary 1% -> started 2026-04-02T13:00Z

Ben Torres: Tests: unit for score math, property tests fuzzing ttl extremes, chaos test under high churn, and an integration sim that replays real hotkey traces.

Alex Rivera: Implementation note: avoid per-request exponentials on hot path. Precompute decay factor table or use approximation, e.g.:

```
# approximation for decay on hot path
decay(age, ttl) = 1 / (1 + age/ttl)  # cheaper than exp(-age/ttl)
```

Priya Kapoor: API: add optional `prefix_ttl` to prefix create/update. Default `null` -> legacy behavior. Document semantics: null => infinite TTL (no decay).

Samir Patel: Back-compat: when `prefix_ttl` absent, treat as legacy infinite ttl with multiplier 1. Also ensure migrations are idempotent.

Maria Chen: Action items: Maria implement descriptor epoch + TTL, Alex prototype fast approximation table, Ben add sim harness & histograms, Priya update API docs, Samir add rollout playbook and flag. I'll open PRs and link here.

Alex Rivera: Ping me on PR for review. Also add perf benchmark: 95p token cost impact for scoring change.

Ben Torres: Also add alert if eviction churn increase > 15% during canary; and rollback criteria if demote_ratio drops below safe threshold.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Filing followups: PRs and runbook. I'll post RFC followup with sample numbers and graphs.

Priya Kapoor: ack, will draft docs and an example `curl` for prefix update.

Samir Patel: leaving note: watch for tenant fairness; we may need an upper cap on tenant_factor per-tenant to avoid noisy neighbors.

evict-bot: Canary health check: eviction-churn=+2% at 2h, demote_ratio stable, no critical alerts.

Maria Chen: Great. Closing loop in 24h unless surprises. :thumbsup:
